author: worker_1
object: Claim: John Adams composed the opera Nixon in China and served as the second President of the United States
belief: The claim is REFUTED because it conflates two different people: John Adams (1735-1826) was the second President of the United States, but he did not compose the opera Nixon in China. The opera Nixon in China was composed by John Coolidge Adams (born 1947), who was never President. No single person named John Adams performed both actions.
